stable_traits.filiations: King of Cairhien, now dead

stable_traits.filiations: Queen of Andor, mother of Elayne and Gawyn

characters.notes: Not physically present. Elayne mentions her mother wouldn't start a war with Tar Valon even if they 'dried and salted' her. Elayne also says that if Morgase even suspected the Black Ajah existed, she would put Elayne in the middle of a battle to get her away from them.

appearances.whereabouts: Her room in the novices' quarters of the White Tower
appearances.notable_actions: Practices channeling by making three small balls of light weave patterns; discusses her fear and compulsion to channel; learns from Liandrin that Rand, Mat, and Perrin are in danger; agrees to go to Toman Head to help them
appearances.demeanor: Fearful yet compulsively drawn to channeling; worried about Rand and protective of her friends; uncomfortable with the tension in the room

appearances.whereabouts: Egwene's room in the novices' quarters
appearances.notable_actions: Paces and glares, still angry from being reprimanded by Sheriam for hitting Irella; loses her temper and accidentally channels wind that knocks over Min; agrees to go to Toman Head despite suspicions about Liandrin; takes charge of planning the journey
appearances.demeanor: Angry, frustrated with Tower authority, struggling to control her temper; protective and suspicious but ultimately committed to helping the boys

appearances.whereabouts: Egwene's room, sitting on a three-legged stool
appearances.notable_actions: Discusses Galad with Egwene; reads danger around all the women when they decide to go; reveals she's tired of being used by the Amyrlin to read people and wants an excuse to leave; insists on joining the journey
appearances.demeanor: Casual, wry, reluctant about her viewing ability; determined to escape the Tower and join the mission

appearances.whereabouts: Egwene's room (and briefly her own adjacent room where she eavesdropped)
appearances.notable_actions: Brings news of King Galldrian's death; discusses seeing Logain crying; eavesdrops on Liandrin's conversation through a hole in the wall; insists on joining the journey to Toman Head despite being Daughter-Heir; jokes about competing with Egwene for Rand
appearances.demeanor: Outwardly composed and playful but admits to being terrified and exhausted from training; determined to have an adventure and escape the drudgery of Tower life

appearances.whereabouts: Egwene's room in the novices' quarters (visits briefly)
appearances.notable_actions: Arrives unexpectedly; sends Min and Elayne away; tells Egwene and Nynaeve that Rand, Mat, and Perrin are in danger from the Shadow; recruits them for a mission to Toman Head; reveals the existence of the Black Ajah and warns them to tell no one; instructs them to meet her at the northernmost edge of the Ogier grove one hour before sunset with horses and supplies
appearances.demeanor: Cold, icy, controlling; shows anger through white spots on her cheeks when challenged; manipulative in her approach

appearances.whereabouts: The practice yards, working with the Warders
appearances.notable_actions: Practices sword forms; is watched by many women including Else; asks Else if Egwene will be walking in the South Garden
appearances.demeanor: Focused on his training; unaware of the attention he receives from women; good-looking and graceful

appearances.whereabouts: Not present in this chapter; mentioned as having been elsewhere in the Tower
appearances.notable_actions: Insulted Nynaeve, calling her clumsy as a cow with half the Talents; got her ear clouted by Nynaeve as a result

appearances.whereabouts: The practice yards (earlier in the day)
appearances.notable_actions: Made eyes at Galad while he was training; was asked by Galad about Egwene's whereabouts but was not noticed romantically by him
appearances.demeanor: Infatuated with Galad; disappointed when he didn't notice her interest

appearances.whereabouts: Inner Court of the White Tower
appearances.notable_actions: Sat on a bench crying; ran away when Elayne saw him
appearances.demeanor: Broken, weeping, ashamed; wants to die after being gentled

relationships.description: Nynaeve supervises Egwene's channeling practice and warns her about the dangers; they are friends and from the same village

Friends who discuss matters together, including Galad and the journey
Friends; they apologize to each other after Nynaeve's temper causes Min to be knocked over by wind

Half-siblings; Galad is Elayne's half-brother
Mother and daughter; Elayne is the Daughter-Heir
Egwene has romantic feelings for Rand and worries deeply about him; she stopped dreaming about him months ago and fears he might be gentled

Egwene finds Galad attractive and can't help staring at him, though she knows she shouldn't

The Amyrlin uses Min repeatedly to read people for her; Min finds it difficult to refuse her requests
Liandrin claims she must work with Moiraine despite disliking her greatly; Nynaeve believes neither would give the other water if she were dying
Liandrin manipulates Egwene into joining a mission to Toman Head by claiming Rand and his friends are in danger
Liandrin recruits Nynaeve for the mission to Toman Head; Nynaeve is suspicious of her motives

Friends from the same village; Egwene agrees to go to Toman Head to help Perrin
